subject.title: [AI-assisted] fix(cli): surface session lane busy exits

question: Should same-session source-entrypoint CLI dispatches return a terminal LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED busy result after the wait threshold, including admin-authority variants such as model override and session reset?
rationale: The PR fixes a real silent CLI failure, but it deliberately changes the delivery contract for queued CLI work and maintainers need to own that compatibility choice before merge.

options.title: Repair And Land CLI Busy Result
options.body: Preserve CLI classification for ordinary and admin-authority source-entrypoint CLI paths without adding a new strict request field, then land after focused tests and maintainer review.

options.title: Accept Default-CLI-Only Scope
options.body: Keep the current branch shape and accept that model override and reset CLI dispatches remain outside the busy-result behavior.

options.title: Pause Busy Contract
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose a different user-facing queue policy or opt-in surface for CLI lane waits.

recommendation.title: Repair And Land CLI Busy Result
recommendation.body: Preserve CLI classification for ordinary and admin-authority source-entrypoint CLI paths without adding a new strict request field, then land after focused tests and maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main CLI/Gateway identity work and blame point to steipete as the best available owner for the delivery-contract choice.
